[IALC.5.3] The six `ds_*` symbols must have default visibility and must
NOT be `static`. For the shipped static archive this is automatic and
override resolves cleanly at link. For shared-object build paths
(the pyds extension) the build must not apply
`-fvisibility=hidden` or `-Bsymbolic` to these symbols, which would bind
libds's internal calls to its own weak defaults and defeat override.
